FQHESphereEntanglementEntropyParticlePartition, version 0.01

Usage: FQHESphereEntanglementEntropyParticlePartition [options] 

Options:

system options:
    --ground-file : name of the file corresponding to the ground state of the whole system
    --haldane : use Haldane basis instead of the usual n-body basis

    -z, --total-lz : twice the total momentum projection for the system (override autodetection from input file name if greater or equal to zero) (default value = -1)
    --min-na : minimum size of the particles whose entropy has to be evaluated (default value = 1)
    --max-na : maximum size of the particles whose entropy has to be evaluated (0 if equal to half the total system size) (default value = 0)
    --min-lza : minimum values of Lz whose sectors has to be evaluated (default value = -1)
    --max-lza : maximum values of Lz whose sectors has to be evaluated (0 if equal to half the total system size) (default value = -1)
    --degenerated-groundstate : single column file describing a degenerated ground state
    --compute-lvalue : compute the L value of each reduced density matrix eigenstate
    --largest-lz : only compute the largest block of the reduced density matrix (Lz=0 or 1/2)
    --positive-lz : only compute the positive Lz sectors
    --realspace-cut : use real space partition instead of particle partition
    --realspace-theta-top : inclination angle that defines the top of the real space parition (in degrees) (default value = 0)
    --realspace-theta-bot : inclination angle that defines the bottom of the real space parition (in degrees) (default value = 90)
    --realspace-phi-range : angle between the 2 longitudes that defines the real space parition (in degrees) (default value = 360)
    --realspace-generic : use a generic real space partition instead of particle partition (geometrical weight has to be provided through this external file)
    --show-time : show time required for each operation

precalculation options:
    --load-hilbert : load Hilbert space description from the indicated file (only available for the Haldane basis)

output options:
    -o, --output-file : use this file name instead of the one that can be deduced from the input file name (replacing the vec extension with partent extension
    --density-matrix : store the eigenvalues of the partial density matrices in the a given file
    --density-eigenstate : compute the eigenstates of the reduced density matrix
    --lza-filter : compute the eigenstates of the reduced density matrix only for a given value of Lza
    --lza-eigenstate : compute the eigenstates of the reduced density matrix only for a subsystem with a fixed total Lz value (default value = 0)
    --nbr-eigenstates : number of reduced density matrix eigenstates to compute (0 if all) (default value = 0)

tools options:
    --use-lapack : use LAPACK libraries instead of DiagHam libraries
    --use-svd : use singular value decomposition instead of diagonalization to compute the entropy
